idea-plugin.name: Changed Method Navigator
idea-plugin.description:
Review local Java changes method-by-method instead of hunting through changed lines across files.

Changed Method Navigator maps IntelliJ's current local VCS changes to Java methods using the IDE's PSI model, then lists only the methods touched by those changes in a dedicated Changed Methods tool window. Select a method to jump directly to it in source.

The initial scope is deliberately narrow: Java files, current local VCS changes, changed-method listing, one-click source navigation, and manual refresh. It does not modify project files, classify the meaning or risk of changes, send source code to an external service, or replace the built-in diff viewer.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial preflight release: identify Java methods touched by current local VCS changes and navigate to them from a dedicated tool window.
